meaning: Published terms, roles and verdict policy for LemmaX demonstration attempts on Monad Testnet. Verdicts check what the settlement contract cannot know. A verdict is a rule-conformance finding, not a resource-quality judgement or a compatibility probability.

terms.chargeRule: A settled attempt charges exactly the execution and evaluation tariff; the caps are headroom reserved for a later metered tariff.

payouts.rule: Credit pays out automatically once it reaches the owner's bar, never below the minimum.

executor.duty: Runs the retrieval; earns only the execution charge.

evaluators.label: Evaluator-b
evaluators.operator: LemmaX (operator-run, labelled fault-injection evaluator for the demonstration)

attribution: Charge verdicts attach to the evaluator signer named in the funded quote. The issuer is flagged only for terms it signed. A buyer refuses new quotes naming a party with a blocking verdict under this rulebook; a new rulebook version is the remediation path.
